tei:div.tei:p: (367)kun slong bcos thabs bzhugs so/ (368)rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ a khu 'bis li ma'i rgyud la bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems rin po che skye nas ci byed byang chub kyi lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ dang po rang gi sems rgyud 'di la brtags nas dge ba gnad du 'gro bar ma byung na ltar snang gi chos pa rang gzhan mgo bskor ba'i bla ma yin zer ba'i ban ma hor zhig gis mi tshe grong chog la bcad nas 'chi khar brang la sen mo btab nas/ chos med lag stong du 'gro ba'i skabs 'char bar gyur ta re/ des na dang po rang gi kun slong la brtags dgos de la gsum/ mi dge ba'i kun slong*/ lung ma bstan pa'i kun slong*/ dge ba'i kun slong gsum/ dang po la gnyis/ 'jig skyobs dang legs smon gyi kun song gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshe 'di'i nad zhi ba dang gdon zhi ba dang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa zhi ba dang*/ mu ge'i 'jigs pa zhi 'dod kyi kun bslang te/ dam pa'i chos sgrub na tshe 'di'i 'jigs pa de dag zhi na ma gtogs 'bras bu cung zad 'byung rgyu (369)med pas do spangs dgos/ logs smon gyi kun bslang ni/ 'phags pa klus/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang*/ snyan dang mi snyan grags dang ma grags dang*/ bstod smad ces bgyi 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ bdag gi yid yul min pa mgo snyom mjod/ ces pa'i 'jig rten tshe 'di'i rnyed bstod snyan grags bzhi po bsgrub byar byed na de'i mthun pa'i phyogs bzhi po spang byas byod nas/ dang po nas chos btsong zhig la kha sa 'thon nas tshe 'di sgrub pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslang te/ nyan 'chad sgom sgrub gang byed thams cad legs smon gyi kun slong yin/ de la ming zhig btags na gsar mas mtshan ma'i rnam par g.yeng ba dang*/ bka' brgyud dang rnying mas chos ltar bcos pa zer te/

mnyam med dwags pos chos chos bzhin ma spyad na chos kyis slar ngan song gi rgyu byed gsungs pa bzhin/ rang rgyud ngan pa bong sha lta bu de dam pa chos kyi ri dwags kyi spu dang rnga ma btsug nas 'tshong ba bzhin/ dam pa'i chos phag g.yar nas chos kyis tshe 'di sgrub pa dang*/ 'jig rten rgad po zhig (370)gis me 'da' zhig bzung nas tshe 'di sgrub pa rgyag po gcig pas da dung dam pa'i chos kyis tshe 'dis sgrub pas thabs sdug te ston pa thugs rje can gyi bskal pa grangs med mang por gsags pa'i dam pa'i chos dmar de dang 'jig rten pa'i nor gyi zongs gnyis brjes pa de la bstan pa'i bla btsong*/ dkon mchog gi rkang 'dren/ dge 'dun gyi rgab sdud pa po yin te/ sa chen gyi/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min gsungs pas spang dgos/ gnyis pa lung ma bstan pa'i kun bslang ni/ mi dred kyi mi'i lad mo byed pa bzhin tshe 'di phyi gang gi 'bras ba la gtad so med par rang bzhin chos zhu dang sgrub dar ba tsam rgyu mtshan du byed nas nyan 'chad bsgom bsgrub gang byed na 'bras bu cung zad tsam yang med pas de bcos dgos/ gsum pa dge ba kun bslang la gsum/ skyes bu chung ngu'i kun slong dang*/ skyes bu 'bring gi kun slong*/ skyes bu chen po'i kun slong gsum las/ dang po ni/ ngan song gsum po sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin mo'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling*/ spu gri'i so lta bur sdug bsngal du mthong*/ mtho ris lha mi'i go 'phang thob 'dod kyi bsam pas kun nas bslang (371)te ma ki nyan thos kyi theg pa nas ya ki 'od gsal rjogs pa chen po'i bar gang nyams su blangs kyang mtho ris thob pa'i rgyu las mi 'phags te/ bsam pa de lta bu'i kun nas bslang te 'dul khrims gnyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum po bsrung*/ chos gos rnam pa gsum po gyon nas 'dug kyang bsam pa rgad po las ma 'phags pas/

rgad po sdom ldan rgad po chos gos can gcig las lam zhugs mtshan nyid pa min/ des na bsam pa des kun nas slong te bskyed rim gyi lha zhi ba rang rgyud pas 'dod khams kyi lha/ khro bo rang rgyud pas 'dod khams kyi bdud dang ru drar skye/ lhun grub thod rgal gyis gzugs khams kyi lha/ ka dag khreg chod kyis gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir skye/ de yang tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong zhig gis ma khyog ni byi ba dang dred mo sogs su skye bas 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min zhes pas de spang dgos so/ gnyis pa skyes bu 'bring gi kun slong ni/ rang 'dod yid byed kyi kun slong gis kun nas bslang te rang nyid gcig pu 'khor ba 'di las thar nas nyan rang dgra bcos pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod kyi bsam (372)pa de yin/ rang 'dod la zhen na sems bskyed min zhes pas byang chub sems dpa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i yon tan med pas de spang dgos/ gsum pa skyes bu chen po'i kun slong ni/ rgyal tshab mi pham pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ yang dag rjogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ ces pas zur gnyis sam don gnyis dang ldan pa byang chub sems kyis kun slong yin te zur dang po snying rjes sems can la dmigs pa ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te bsam pa yin/ zur phyi ma shes rab kyi rjogs byang la dmigs pa ni/ rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya bsam pa de yin te/ des na sngon gyi bka' gdams pa gong ma dag gis zhal nas rang 'dod yid byed kyi bsam pa 'di la 'gong po zhes dang*/ gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems 'di la 'gong po 'gong rjong gi cho ga zhes gsungs la/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ mang du bshad lta ci zhig dgos/ byis pas rang don sgrub pa dang*/ thub pas gzhan don mjad pa yi/ 'di gnyis kyis ni khyad par ltos/ zhes pas skyon yon bsam par bya'o/

(373)'di snying thag pa nas ma bsam na byang chub sems dpar btags kyang ci yang mi 'ong bas/ des na bsam dgos pas/ mar shes pa/ drin dran pa/ drin bzo 'dod kyi rtogs pa bskyed/ sdug bsngal bral 'dod kyi snying rje dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod kyi bsam pa bskyed pa'o/ dang po ni/ mar shes pa la rang gi ma rgan de phung khams skye mched ji ltar bar bsgom la 'di ltar nam mkha'i gar khyab sems can gyis khyab/ sems can gyis gar khyab las snang sdug bsngal kyis mnar ba'i sems can 'di rnams kyi thog ma med pa'i dus nas/ pha dang ma dang*/ gnyen dang mja' bshes ma byed pa'i sems can med khyad par snying nye ba'i dbang du byas na ma ma byed pa'i sems can gcig kyang med/ ma byed pa de yang lan gcig tsam ma yin par ma lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byed de/ 'di ltar 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba 'dir 'khor bas lha dang dmyal bar phal cher ma gtogs ma med par mi skye/ thams cad mngal nas skye ba sha stag pas ma lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par byas pa yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ ma (374)yi thug mtha' rgya shugs tshig gu rtsam/ ril bu dril kyang sa yi long mi 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so/ gnyis pa drin dran pa ni/ 'jig rten lugs kyis drin dran pa dang*/ chos kyi lugs kyis drin dran pa gnyis las/ dang po las/ lus bskyed pa dang*/ srog sbyin pa dang*/ yo byad bstabs pa dang*/ 'jig rten bstan pa'i drin rnams so/ dang po ni/ dri za nye bar len pa'i rnam par shes pa de ma'i mngal du zhugs pas zla dgu ngo dang bcu'i bar du mngal du bzung*/ kha zas kyi dwangs ma bu'i lte ba nas brgyud de lus bskyed/ gnyis pa ni/ phyir btsal ba'i dus na/ gson po red byas na mgo mi khyogs/ shi pho red byas na dbugs ma chad pa nya re nyo re phud bu tsam pa de/ drin mo che a ma bu skye byung snyam pa'i dga' po chen po dang bcas nas/

'chi rgyu 'chi ma bcug par sor mo bcu'i kha la g.yeng*/ 'jum pa'i mig gis bltas/ snyan pa'i ngag gis bos/ rtse ba'i sems kyis bskyang pa'i drin dran/ gsum pa ni/ bar do'i sems can snga ltas byed na dang po gang du thon yod mi shes/ phyi ltas zhig byed na/ gang nas (375)'ong mi shes pa'i sprang rgan zhig yin pas ma drin mo che des kha zas med zas dang sprad/ lag nor med nor dang sprad/ rgyab gos med gos dang sprad de zas kyi dang po mngar ba'i nu zho bsnun/ gos kyi dang po sha drod la bcal/ zas kyi phud byin/ gos kyi rtses g.yog shin tu byams pas bsreng ba'i drin chen yin pa'i drin dran/ bzhi pa 'jig rten bstan pa ni/ za mi shes pa la za lo bslob/ 'gro mi shes pa la 'gro lob/ gyon mi shes pa la gyon lob bslab/ smra mi shes pa la smra lob slob/ 'jig rten 'dis su dang mi mnyam pa med pa dang mnyam par byed/ mnyam gnyis gong gi rgyal po de ma rgan gyi drin yin pas de thams cad snying nas dran dgos/ drin gzo 'dod kyi rtogs pa bskyed pa ni/ da snga phan chod ma rgan gyis khe dang rgyal kha bu la byin/ gyong dang bub kha ma rang gis len pa bde skyid bde ba'i dngos po'i shas thams cad bu la byin/ sdug bsngal kyi shas thams cad ma rang gis blangs nas mas bu'i skyid sdug la bltas pas da res bu nga'i res la bab pas khe dang rgyal kha ma la byin/ gyong dang bub kha (376)thams cad rang gi len bsam du bsgoms/ bzhi pa sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje bsgom pa ni/ ma drin mo che 'dis 'dod rgyu ci 'dod gin yod gi bsam na/ 'dod rgyu bde ba 'dod/ mi 'dod rgyu sdug bsngal mim 'dod kyang*/ bde ba'i rgyu dge ba dang yang dag pa'i lam bcu bsgrub mi shes/ gal srid tshul bzhin ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni med/ tshul bzhin bka' ni mi sgrub/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa la 'tshol nyog tu spyod de sdug bsngal bden pas dngos su gnod/

kun 'byung bden pas brgyud de gnod pas sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis po de dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du smon pa dang 'brel ba dang*/ bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang 'brel ba dang*/ bral ba zhig ngas bya snyam pa'i dam bca' dang 'brel ba'o/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral ba'i ched du dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ de rnams ni zur dang po snying rjes sems can la dmigs pa'o/ gnyis pa zur phyi ma shes rab kyi rdzogs byang la dmigs pa ni/ gdam nga zhig byed na/ mtho ris lha mi'i go 'phang la bkod na yang de sngon de 'dra ba'i go (377)'phag la bkod na yang de sngon de 'dra ba'i go 'phang mang po thob kyang ma drag pas de la bkod kyang phan med/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang la bkod kyang de yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las thar ba yin kyang*/ byang sems kyi sa dang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad med pas de la bkod kyang phan med/ des na srid zhi'i gnyis ka'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god dgos snyams du shes rab kyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god 'dod kyi bsam pa bskyed do/ de ltar dngapo rang gi rtsa ba'i ma la bskyed/ de nas pha la bskyed/ de nas sha nye spun zla la bskyed/ de nas yul 'khor dang nam mkha'i mtha' khyab la bsgom dgos so/ o de ltar blo sbyong ba'i sgo nas rang 'dod yid byed kyi bsam pa 'di la dus nam yin yang skyon du bltas nas/ phrin las rno po drag sngags kyi nus pa thams cad bdag 'jin gyi 'gong po 'di'i steng du kha phyung lag phyung byed dgos/ de min pa'i chos pa bzang po rang gzhan la phan pa'i bla ma chen po 'ong dka'/ gal srid tshe phyi ma'i rgyu 'bras gar la mi lta ba'i 'di snang tshe 'di'i 'dug chus la blo phug gtad/ ci byed tshe 'di'i snon ma'i bla mar 'gro bas rgyu mtshan des na dang po tshul (378)khrims kyi bslab pa la srog brdol la btang*/

de nas tshe 'di la blo'i zhen pa gting nas log pa zhig dgos/ de nas rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor la mig 'bras bzhin gzab dgos/ de nas dam pa'i chos la sha spar 'tham pa zhig dgos/ bdag 'jinal dgra ltar blta dgos/ byang chub kyi sems la yid bzhin gyi nor bu bas gces spras byed dgos/ de min bri tshod mi 'dug lag pa na bas smyo 'o 'bis

hor po sad lhung ba 'dom thog bsam gtan/ mtshan/ li ma da ni smyo 'a de tshe 'di snang la gyis drang po de dam pa'i chos la thon/ de tsho nyan na gna' snga mo'i chos sa so so'i lam dang mthun 'ong gi da lta'i chos sa tshos ci lab lab la thong*/ mkhan po'i ming gis ba dan lhab lhub tu g.yo ba'i ngag dbang dpal bzang gis bris pa dge'o/ kha dge sna dge //
